title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
title_zh: 用于 LLM 智能体训练的匹配上下文群体策略优化

paragraphs.en: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO) , a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response’s original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment–backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47–1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state–rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.
paragraphs.zh: 训练长时域语言模型智能体需要将稀疏的终端反馈中的功劳分配给中间决策。 在有限数量的兄弟式展开中，有用的动作比较取决于其上下文、对两种替代方案的支持证据，以及这些证据如何进入学习过程。 我们提出匹配上下文组策略优化（MCGPO），一种从已收集轨迹中构建加权动作偏好的方法。 MCGPO通过任务规则标注的预动作状态摘要和观察到的评分标准进展来定义比较上下文。 双动作支持在有序的精确匹配规则和粗略匹配规则中进行选择。 固定折叠将候选决策与用于指导其偏好的终端结果分离，而支持依赖的证据权重则在与共享的GraphGPO任务学习并行的辅助成对目标上进行缩放。 MCGPO重复使用展开数据和每个响应的原始历史，从而保持无评论家的训练方式。 在六种环境-主干设置中（每种设置包含三个训练种子），MCGPO相较于匹配的GraphGPO提升了平均成功率：在使用Qwen2.5-1.5B和7B模型时，ALFWorld和WebShop分别提升了0.47至1.46个百分点；在使用Qwen3-4B和8B模型时，WebShop分别提升了3.96和5.16个点。 ALFWorld的增益建立于超过92%的基线成功率之上，此时剩余的提升空间有限。 在四种Qwen2.5设置中的三种，集成成功率得到了提升。 三种子因子对照支持反向折叠证据和证据加权；状态-评分标准联合匹配在所有四种表示-控制设置中实现了最高的平均值。

paragraphs.en: Training large language model agents requires credit assignment : sparse terminal rewards must guide the intermediate actions that shape task outcomes ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . In ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , success depends on a sequence of interdependent decisions. Group-relative reinforcement learning offers critic-free updates by comparing outcomes within a group of sampled responses or trajectories ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Ahmadian et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . For multi-turn agents, GiGPO localizes these comparisons at recurring anchor states ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , while trajectory-graph methods extract step credit from collected transitions ( Li et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . However, grouping by repeated states or transitions can compare decisions with different prior task progress, obscuring what their outcome contrast represents.
paragraphs.zh: 训练大型语言模型智能体需要信用分配：稀疏的终端奖励必须指导形成任务结果的中间动作（Zhou 等，2024；Chen 等，2025；Wang 等，2025）。 在 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等，2021）和 WebShop（Yao 等，2022）中，成功取决于一系列相互依赖的决策。 群体相对强化学习通过比较采样响应或轨迹组内的结果，实现无需评论家的更新（Shao 等，2024；Ahmadian 等，2024；Yu 等，2025）。 对于多轮智能体，GiGPO 将这些比较定位在重复出现的锚定状态（Feng 等，2025），而轨迹图方法则从收集到的转移中提取步骤信用（Li 等，2026b；Cheng 等，2026）。 然而，根据重复状态或转移进行分组可能会将不同先前任务进展的决策进行比较，从而掩盖其结果对比所代表的含义。

paragraphs.en: This mismatch arises when the same state summary describes different remaining decision problems . A page, location, or inventory summary may omit progress established before the current choice. Consequently, an action taken after more prerequisites have been met can inherit a higher success rate, while a useful action taken earlier can receive weaker relative feedback. Their outcome contrast can mix prior progress with the contribution of the current action. A captured ALFWorld task illustrates this representational issue: two empty-handed visits to the same countertop share a coarse state key, although one follows acquiring and relocating a target object (Appendix D ). Adding context can separate such decisions, but stricter conditions also reduce the repeated evidence available for comparing different actions.
paragraphs.zh: 当同一个状态摘要描述了不同的剩余决策问题时，就会出现这种不匹配。 页面、位置或库存摘要可能会省略在当前选择之前已经取得的进展。 因此，在满足更多前提条件之后采取的行动可能继承更高的成功率，而较早采取的有效行动则可能获得较弱的相对反馈。 它们结果的差异可能会将之前的进展与当前行动的贡献混合在一起。 一个已捕获的 ALFWorld 任务说明了这种表示问题：两次空手前往同一柜台的情况共享一个粗略的状态键，尽管其中一次是在获取并移动目标物体之后发生的（附录 D）。 增加上下文信息可以区分这类决策，但更严格的条件也会减少可用于比较不同行动的重复证据。

paragraphs.en: Recent work enriches comparison context to address this tension. HGPO combines groups at multiple history depths, and BiPACE uses policy representations and action-conditioned peer baselines ( He et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Task structure offers another source of context: explicit criteria guide reward aggregation ( Gunjal et al., 2025 ; Lv et al., 2026 ) , policy stages and memory ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and milestone-level credit ( Wang et al., 2026d ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . However, an explicit preference between different actions also needs evidence for both alternatives. A richer context can leave one action poorly supported, so a larger outcome gap may reflect only a few trajectories. The remaining challenge is to select comparisons and weight their influence using the evidence available within a finite rollout group. This leads to our research question:
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究通过丰富比较上下文来缓解这种矛盾。 HGPO 结合了多个历史深度上的组别，而 BiPACE 则使用了策略表示和行动条件化的同伴基线（He et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a）。 任务结构提供了另一种上下文来源：明确的准则指导奖励聚合（Gunjal et al., 2025；Lv et al., 2026）、策略阶段和记忆（Li et al., 2026a），以及里程碑级别的信用分配（Wang et al., 2026d；Qian et al., 2026）。 然而，不同行动之间的明确偏好也需要为两种选择都提供证据支持。 更丰富的上下文可能导致某个行动缺乏充分支持，因此较大的结果差异可能仅反映少数几条轨迹的情况。 剩下的挑战是，在有限的展开组内利用现有证据来选择比较对象并衡量其影响权重。 这引出了我们的研究问题：

paragraphs.en: Research Question How can a finite group of existing rollouts supply supported local action preferences for policy learning?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题：有限数量的现有 rollout 如何能为策略学习提供受支持的地方动作偏好？

paragraphs.en: We introduce MCGPO (Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization) to construct auxiliary action preferences from collected sibling rollouts. The core idea is to select a comparison context supported by both actions before forming a weighted preference. Match groups pre-action decisions by state summaries and observed rubric progress, with a rule-derived frontier annotating progress. It tries ordered exact and coarse state rules, selecting the first with evidence for both actions. Label uses terminal outcomes from the opposite fixed fold to orient pairs and assign support-discounted evidence weights. Learn optimizes a weighted pairwise objective alongside the shared GraphGPO task objective. The labels express observational outcome contrasts under the rollout policy; their weights control each pair’s optimization contribution. MCGPO reuses rollout data and preserves critic-free training and each response’s original history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MCGPO（匹配上下文组策略优化），用于从收集到的兄弟策略执行轨迹中构建辅助动作偏好。 其核心思想是在形成加权偏好之前，选择一个两种动作都支持的比较上下文。 通过状态摘要和观察到的评分标准进展来匹配动作前的决策，并由规则推导出的边界标注进展。 它会尝试有序的精确状态规则和粗略状态规则，并选择第一个对两种动作都有证据支持的那一个。 标签使用来自相反固定折叠的终端结果来指导成对比较，并分配经过折扣的支持证据权重。 Learn 模块在共享的 GraphGPO 任务目标之外，还优化一个加权成对目标函数。 这些标签表达了在策略执行轨迹政策下的观察结果差异；它们的权重控制着每对比较在优化中的贡献度。 MCGPO 重用了策略执行轨迹数据，同时保留了无需评论器的训练方式以及每个响应的原始历史。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MCGPO on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, using three training runs per setting. Mean success improves over matched GraphGPO in all four settings by 0.47–1.46 percentage points, including ALFWorld baselines already above 92% success. A three-seed WebShop extension yields gains of 3.96 and 5.16 points with Qwen3-4B and 8B, respectively. Integrated success over the full training horizon improves in three Qwen2.5 settings, with positive paired differences in each of their three seeds. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting. Across all four representation-control settings, joint state–rubric conditioning raises three-seed mean success over both State-only and Rubric-only matching. These results demonstrate performance gains across the tested backbones and support joint state–rubric conditioning as an effective comparison design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 7B，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上对 MCGPO 进行了评估，每种设置均执行三次训练运行。 在所有四种设置中，平均成功率相较于匹配的 GraphGPO 提升了 0.47–1.46 个百分点，其中 ALFWorld 的基线模型成功率已超过 92%。 在 WebShop 的三种子扩展实验中，Qwen3-4B 和 8B 分别获得了 3.96 和 5.16 个百分点的提升。 在整个训练周期内的集成成功率在三种 Qwen2.5 设置中均有提升，且其三个种子的配对差异均为正值。 三种子因子对照支持反向倍数证据和证据加权分析。 在所有四种表示-控制设置中，联合状态-评分标准条件化使三种子平均成功率高于仅匹配状态或仅匹配评分标准的方案。 这些结果展示了所测试骨干模型的性能提升，并支持将联合状态-评分标准条件化作为一种有效的对比设计。

paragraphs.en: Agent RL learns from interaction outcomes ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) , with GRPO, RLOO, and DAPO estimating within-group advantages ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Ahmadian et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . GiGPO groups anchor states; HGPO combines historical-context depths ( Feng et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ) . SALT matches recent interaction histories, while GraphGPO and RTMC aggregate credit through transition graphs and shared-state trees ( Li et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . In the same sparse-reward, long-horizon setting, G 2 PO merges identical observations into a global state-transition graph and standardizes temporal-difference errors across edges to assign action credit ( Wang et al., 2026c ) . AT-GRPO adapts tree-expansion depth to dialogue stage ( Peng et al., 2026 ) ; STAPO selects steps using state-normalized entropy and combines trajectory-aware rewards with trajectory-independent penalties ( Qi et al., 2026 ) . Other designs use peer baselines, progress signals, or hierarchical updates ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Fan & Liu, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . ECPO calibrates anchor-state credit using action-return shrinkage and reliability gates ( Li et al., 2026c ) . MCGPO instead constructs action-pair supervision: pre-action state and rubric progress define comparability, two-action support selects the matching resolution, and opposite-fold outcomes label an auxiliary pairwise objective.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习通过交互结果进行学习（Zhou 等，2024；Chen 等，2025；Wang 等，2025；Luo 等，2025），其中 GRPO、RLOO 和 DAPO 用于估计组内优势值（Shao 等，2024；Ahmadian 等，2024；Yu 等，2025）。 GiGPO 将锚定状态分组；HGPO 则结合历史上下文深度信息（Feng 等，2025；He 等，2026）。 SALT 匹配近期的交互历史，而 GraphGPO 和 RTMC 则通过转移图和共享状态树聚合信用值（Li 等，2026b；Cheng 等，2026；Wang 等，2026b）。 在相同的稀疏奖励、长时域设定中，G2PO 将相同观测合并为全局状态转移图，并对各边的时序差分误差进行标准化，以分配动作信用值（Wang 等，2026c）。 AT-GRPO 根据对话阶段调整树展开深度（Peng 等，2026）；STAPO 使用状态归一化熵选择步骤，并结合轨迹相关奖励与轨迹无关的惩罚项（Qi 等，2026）。 其他设计则采用同伴基线、进展信号或分层更新机制（Wang 等，2026a；Fan & Liu，2026；Yang 等，2026；Tan 等，2026；Jin 等，2026）。 ECPO 通过动作回报收缩和可靠性门控机制校准锚定状态的信用值（Li 等，2026c）。 MCGPO 则转而构建动作对监督机制：动作前的状态与评分标准定义可比性，双动作支持选择匹配的解决方案，而反向折叠结果则为辅助的对偶目标提供标签。

paragraphs.en: We organize the evaluation around four questions: whether MCGPO improves task completion and learning progress (RQ1), how comparison conditions, outcome evidence, and preference learning contribute (RQ2), how matched contexts produce weighted supervision on WebShop (RQ3), and whether the WebShop gains extend to Qwen3 backbones (RQ4).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估围绕四个问题展开：MCGPO 是否提升了任务完成度和学习进展（研究问题1），比较条件、结果证据和偏好学习分别发挥了怎样的作用（研究问题2），匹配的上下文如何在 WebShop 中实现加权监督（研究问题3），以及 WebShop 的改进能否迁移到 Qwen3 主干模型上（研究问题4）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate household interaction in ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) and product search and purchase in WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . The main experiments use Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , with training seeds 0, 1, and 2. GraphGPO supplies the shared task-credit objective and matched baseline, measuring the effect of the complete rubric-conditioned preference branch. WebShop rubric extraction uses structured training information from the goal scorer, including attribute, option, and price matches and a pre-purchase preview score (Appendix A.1 ). Controls include GraphGPO with rubric-event shaping. For Qwen3-4B/8B, GraphGPO + shaping uses the same scorer information as MCGPO through training rewards, with three seeds per backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2021）中评估家庭互动，在 WebShop（Yao 等人，2022）中评估产品搜索与购买。 主要实验使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Yang 等人，2024），训练种子为 0、1 和 2。 GraphGPO 提供共享任务信用目标及匹配的基线模型，用于衡量完整评分标准条件偏好分支的效果。 WebShop 的评分标准提取使用了来自目标评分器的结构化训练信息，包括属性、选项和价格匹配，以及购买前预览得分（附录 A.1）。 对照组包括采用评分标准-事件塑造的 GraphGPO。 对于 Qwen3-4B/8B，GraphGPO + 塑造方法通过训练奖励使用与 MCGPO 相同的评分器信息，每个主干模型使用三个种子。

paragraphs.en: We complement the update-axis curves with a retrospective budget comparison on Qwen2.5-1.5B. paragraphs.en: w/ Shuffled Rubric permutes pre-action ( C , F ) (C,F) labels among same-task decision rows, disrupting their alignment with actual progress. Success falls by 2.34 points on WebShop and 0.63 on ALFWorld. The Candidate-progress labels variant uses the candidate trajectories’ progress evidence in place of opposite-fold terminal outcomes to label comparisons, reducing success by 1.41 and 3.13 points. This joint replacement changes evidence source, label content, and available support. Its result favors the complete terminal-outcome preference design over the candidate-progress alternative.
paragraphs.zh: w/ Shuffled Rubric 将同一任务决策行中行动前 (C, F) (C,F) 的标签进行置换，破坏了它们与实际进展的一致性。 WebShop 上的成功分数下降了 2.34 分，ALFWorld 上下降了 0.63 分。 Candidate-progress 标签变体使用候选轨迹的进展证据来替代反向折叠的最终结果进行标签比较，使成功分数分别下降 1.41 分和 3.13 分。 这种联合替换改变了证据来源、标签内容和可用支持。 其结果更倾向于完整的最终结果偏好设计，而非候选进展的替代方案。

GraphGPO + Rubric Shaping adds positive-progress rewards and regression penalties to the task rewards, retaining GraphGPO credit assignment with the pairwise loss disabled. paragraphs.en: Joint state–rubric conditioning gives the highest three-seed mean success in all four settings, exceeding State-only by 3.96–9.90 percentage points and Rubric-only by 5.15–9.01 points (Appendix C.4 ). The gains persist at the terminal evaluation in all four settings. With preference construction and the learning objective fixed, these gains support conditioning action comparisons and their terminal evidence jointly on state and progress. WebShop State-only already retains task-match score bins in its coarse state, placing this comparison within a scorer-assisted training setting.
paragraphs.zh: 联合状态–评分标准条件化在所有四种设置中均实现了最高第三种子平均成功率，比仅使用状态的条件化高出 3.96–9.90 个百分点，比仅使用评分标准的条件化高出 5.15–9.01 个百分点（附录 C.4）。 在所有四种设置中，这些增益在最终评估时仍然存在。 在偏好构建和学习目标固定的情况下，这些增益支持将动作比较及其最终证据联合基于状态和进展进行条件化。 WebShop 的“仅状态”方法在其粗略状态中已经保留了任务匹配分数区间，因此这一比较属于评分器辅助的训练设置。

paragraphs.en: Across six environment–backbone settings, MCGPO improves three-seed mean success over matched GraphGPO, including ALFWorld baselines above 92% and Qwen3 WebShop gains of 3.96 and 5.16 points. Representation and factorial controls support joint context matching, opposite-fold evidence, and evidence weighting; scorer-matched comparisons favor MCGPO over reward shaping. Together, these results support extracting useful action-level supervision from existing rollout groups.

paragraphs.en: This experiment compares two ways of using the same scorer-derived supervision, testing whether the complete MCGPO preference-learning scheme improves on reward shaping. For Qwen3-4B/8B, GraphGPO + shaping uses all scorer information available to MCGPO (Appendix A.1 ) through training rewards. Table 13 reports the three-method comparison and paired gains across seeds 0, 1, and 2. MCGPO improves mean success over shaping by 2.29 points at 4B and 2.66 at 8B, with positive gains in all six paired runs. These results support the complete MCGPO scheme as a more effective use of the scorer signals than the compared reward-shaping alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 本实验比较了两种使用相同评分器衍生监督的方法，旨在检验完整的 MCGPO 偏好学习方案是否优于奖励塑造方法。 对于 Qwen3-4B/8B，GraphGPO + 塑造方法通过训练奖励，利用了 MCGPO 可获得的所有评分器信息（附录 A.1）。 表 13 报告了三种方法的比较结果以及种子 0、1 和 2 上的成对增益。 在 4B 模型上，MCGPO 的平均成功率比塑造方法高出 2.29 分，在 8B 模型上则高出 2.66 分，且所有六次成对运行中均呈现正向增益。 这些结果支持将完整的 MCGPO 方案视为比所比较的奖励塑造替代方案更有效的评分器信号利用方式。

paragraphs.en: The ALFWorld analysis includes all 750 updates from three completed Full runs. Windows 26–50, 101–125, and 226–250 contain 25 updates per seed. Mean training success rises from 60.3% to 89.9% and 95.3%, while mean rollout length falls from 29.34 to 13.91 and 10.17 steps. Length counts active interactions per distinct trajectory, including successful, failed, and truncated runs under the 50-step cap. Mean anchor-state group size rises from 4.10 to 5.54 and 6.62; it counts decision rows sharing task and observation, including repeated visits. These are joint training trends; component effects are assessed in RQ2.
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld 分析包含了三次完整运行中全部 750 次更新。 第 26–50、101–125 和 226–250 个窗口每个种子包含 25 次更新。 平均训练成功率从 60.3% 提升至 89.9% 和 95.3%，而平均展开长度则从 29.34 降至 13.91 和 10.17 步。 长度统计每个独立轨迹中的有效交互次数，包括在 50 步限制下成功、失败和截断的运行。 平均锚定状态组规模从 4.10 提升至 5.54 和 6.62；该指标统计共享任务与观测的决策行，包括重复访问的情况。 这些是联合训练的趋势；各组成部分的影响将在 RQ2 中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: MCGPO is evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen backbones. Transfer to other domains requires suitable state summaries, rubric channels, and task rules; WebShop also uses structured goal-scorer information during training. Preferences are inferred from finite groups of observational rollouts: coarse matching can retain outcome-relevant differences, and terminal success depends on subsequent decisions as well as the matched action. Evidence weighting moderates the influence of sparse comparisons, while direct validation of local action preferences remains an important direction. Our main comparisons use three training seeds and repeated evaluation on a fixed validation set, so small gains retain statistical uncertainty. Evaluation with broader model families, more seeds, and independent test tasks would further assess generalization and statistical precision.
paragraphs.zh: MCGPO 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 数据集上，基于 Qwen 骨干模型进行了评估。 向其他领域迁移需要合适的状态摘要、评分标准通道和任务规则；WebShop 在训练过程中也使用了结构化的目标评分信息。 偏好是从有限的观察性执行轨迹组中推断出来的：粗略匹配可以保留与结果相关的差异，而最终成功不仅取决于后续决策，还取决于所匹配的动作。 证据加权可以调节稀疏比较的影响，而对局部动作偏好的直接验证仍然是一个重要的研究方向。 我们的主要比较使用了三种训练种子，并在固定的验证集上进行了重复评估，因此微小的改进仍存在统计不确定性。 使用更广泛的模型家族、更多训练种子以及独立的测试任务进行评估，将能进一步评估其泛化能力和统计精度。
